newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Envoy says no genuine Rwanda refugees left in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Envoy says no genuine Rwanda refugees left in Zaire.

text.p: Rwanda's U.N. envoy said on Monday there were no more genuine Rwandan refugees in Eastern Zaire, only some 40,000 former Rwandan soldiers and their families who refused to return home.

Ambassador Gideon Kayinamura told a news conference the former Rwandan soldiers, together with mercenaries financed by a European country he declined to identify, were fighting alongside the Zairean army against Zairean rebels.
"Zaire is claiming that there are more than one million Rwandan refugees inside Zaire...We do not have any more refugees inside Zaire," he said, referring to a mass return home late last year.
"The soldiers walked into the forest with their arms to join the Zairean army. These are the ones who the humanitarian agencies say need assistance. We hope they don't extend them refugee status."
These agencies in the past "had fallen into a trap" of providing assistance that was used to feed an army inside a refugee camp, he added.

Kayinamura was referring to soldiers of Rwanda's former Hutu government responsible for genocidal massacres in 1994 in which up to a million Tutsis and Hutu moderates were killed. Many of the soldiers fled to avoid retribution when a Tutsi-led government took power in Rwanda.

"The former Rwanda government soldiers who are in Zaire range between 30,000 to 40,000 soldiers and they have been now reintegrated in the Zairean regular army, with the support of the mercenaries from all over the world," he said.
The mercenaries were "being financed by one European country, using some offshore banking in some parts of the world," he said, but repeatedly declined to identify the country concerned.

Kayinamura categorically denied what he called a "disinformation crusade" by Zairean Foreign Minister Kamanda Wa Kamanda and others who had accused Rwanda of being involved in Zaire's internal crisis.
He said the mercenaries and former Rwandan soldiers had the long-term objective of "externalizing the Zairean conflict to its neighbouring countries."
